title: ITC extends Braille-enabled packaging to Fiama, takes total to 16 SKUs
description:
Alongside an industry-wide shift toward AI-enabled personalisation and algorithmic optimisation, diversified conglomerate ITC Ltd is pursuing an analogue, inclusive approach to product innovation by incorporating raised Braille text on select personal care items from its Savlon and Fiama portfolios.
The initiative makes everyday consumer products more accessible to millions of visually impaired people in India, for whom routine activities such as identifying a handwash bottle or choosing the right personal care product can pose challenges.
Building on Savlon's introduction of India's first Braille-enabled FMCG packaging in 2018, ITC's Personal Care Products Business has now extended the initiative to Fiama. It now has 16 SKUs from the personal care segment under accessible packaging.
Braille identifiers are currently featured on technically feasible product packs, such as Savlon Antiseptic Disinfectant Liquid, Savlon Wet Wipes and Handwash Pumps, as well as Fiama Shower Gels.
